Gross Profit.expr: IF(NOT ISBLANK([Revenue]) && NOT ISBLANK([Direct Costs]), [Revenue] - [Direct Costs])

RETURN IF(COUNTROWS(FILTER(v_TaxRows, NOT ISBLANK('Fact_IncomeTax'[Tax Expense]))) = v_MonthsRequired * COUNTROWS(v_Companies), SUMX(v_TaxRows, 'Fact_IncomeTax'[Tax Expense]))

Balance Mapping Pending.expr:
VAR v_AsOf = EOMONTH(MAX('Dim_Date'[Date]), 0)
VAR v_Company = SELECTEDVALUE('Dim_Company'[Company ID])
VAR v_Currency = SELECTEDVALUE('Dim_Company'[Currency])
VAR v_RequiredIDs = CALCULATETABLE(VALUES('Fact_Accounting'[Account ID]), REMOVEFILTERS('Dim_Date'), 'Fact_Accounting'[Period Date] = v_AsOf, 'Dim_Account'[Account Level] = 2, 'Dim_Account'[Balance Class] IN {"Requires Detail", "Debt"})
RETURN SUMX(v_RequiredIDs,
 VAR v_Id = 'Fact_Accounting'[Account ID]
 VAR v_Net = CALCULATE(SUM('Fact_Accounting'[Debit YTD]) - SUM('Fact_Accounting'[Credit YTD]), REMOVEFILTERS('Dim_Date'), REMOVEFILTERS('Dim_Account'), 'Fact_Accounting'[Period Date] = v_AsOf, 'Fact_Accounting'[Account ID] = v_Id)
 VAR v_Parts = FILTER('Fact_BalanceBreakdown', 'Fact_BalanceBreakdown'[Company ID] = v_Company && 'Fact_BalanceBreakdown'[Period Date] = v_AsOf && 'Fact_BalanceBreakdown'[Account ID] = v_Id && 'Fact_BalanceBreakdown'[Approved] = TRUE())
 VAR v_Invalid = COUNTROWS(FILTER(v_Parts, ISBLANK('Fact_BalanceBreakdown'[Value]) || 'Fact_BalanceBreakdown'[Currency] <> v_Currency || NOT ('Fact_BalanceBreakdown'[Balance Class] IN {"Current Asset","Non-Current Asset","Current Liability","Non-Current Liability","Equity"})))
 VAR v_SignedParts = SUMX(v_Parts, IF('Fact_BalanceBreakdown'[Balance Class] IN {"Current Asset","Non-Current Asset"},1,-1) * 'Fact_BalanceBreakdown'[Value])
 RETURN IF(COUNTROWS(v_Parts) = 0 || v_Invalid > 0 || ISBLANK(v_Net) || ABS(v_Net - v_SignedParts) > 0.01, 1, 0))

Current Assets.expr:
VAR v_AsOf = EOMONTH(MAX('Dim_Date'[Date]), 0)
VAR v_Company = SELECTEDVALUE('Dim_Company'[Company ID])
VAR v_Eligible = CALCULATETABLE(VALUES('Fact_Accounting'[Account ID]), REMOVEFILTERS('Dim_Date'), 'Fact_Accounting'[Period Date] = v_AsOf, 'Dim_Account'[Account Level] = 2, 'Dim_Account'[Balance Class] IN {"Requires Detail", "Debt"})
VAR v_Extra = FILTER('Fact_BalanceBreakdown', 'Fact_BalanceBreakdown'[Company ID] = v_Company && 'Fact_BalanceBreakdown'[Period Date] = v_AsOf && 'Fact_BalanceBreakdown'[Balance Class] = "Current Asset" && 'Fact_BalanceBreakdown'[Account ID] IN v_Eligible && 'Fact_BalanceBreakdown'[Approved] = TRUE())
RETURN IF([Balance Mapping Pending] = 0 && NOT ISBLANK([Cash]) && NOT ISBLANK([Accounts Receivable]) && NOT ISBLANK([Inventory / WIP]), [Cash] + [Accounts Receivable] + [Inventory / WIP] + IF(COUNTROWS(v_Extra) = 0, 0, SUMX(v_Extra,'Fact_BalanceBreakdown'[Value])))
Current Assets.desc: Approved split balances of account groups 23–28 must reconcile to the signed BG balance to 0.01 CVE. Empty current-class subset adds zero only after full reconciliation.

VAR v_SnapshotDate = CALCULATE(MAX('Fact_ProjectMetrics'[Reference Date]), 'Fact_ProjectMetrics'[Phase] = v_Phase, 'Fact_ProjectMetrics'[Reference Date] <= v_RefDate)
VAR v_RowsAtDate = CALCULATETABLE('Fact_ProjectMetrics', 'Fact_ProjectMetrics'[KPI ID] = v_Id, 'Fact_ProjectMetrics'[Phase] = v_Phase, 'Fact_ProjectMetrics'[Reference Date] = v_SnapshotDate)
RETURN IF(HASONEVALUE('Dim_Project'[Project ID]) && COUNTROWS(v_RowsAtDate) = 1, SUMX(v_RowsAtDate, 'Fact_ProjectMetrics'[Value]))

IRR.expr:
VAR v_Phase = SELECTEDVALUE('SIM_Phase'[Phase], "CURRENT")
VAR v_Reference = MAX('Dim_Date'[Date])
VAR v_Snapshot = CALCULATE(MAX('Fact_ProjectCashFlow'[Snapshot Date]), 'Fact_ProjectCashFlow'[Phase] = v_Phase, 'Fact_ProjectCashFlow'[Snapshot Date] <= v_Reference)
VAR v_Flows = FILTER('Fact_ProjectCashFlow', 'Fact_ProjectCashFlow'[Phase] = v_Phase && NOT ISBLANK('Fact_ProjectCashFlow'[Equity Cash Flow]))
RETURN IF(HASONEVALUE('Dim_Project'[Project ID]) && COUNTROWS(FILTER(v_Flows, 'Fact_ProjectCashFlow'[Equity Cash Flow] < 0)) > 0 && COUNTROWS(FILTER(v_Flows, 'Fact_ProjectCashFlow'[Equity Cash Flow] > 0)) > 0, XIRR(v_Flows, 'Fact_ProjectCashFlow'[Equity Cash Flow], 'Fact_ProjectCashFlow'[Date], 0.1, BLANK()))

NPV.expr:
VAR v_Phase = SELECTEDVALUE('SIM_Phase'[Phase], "CURRENT")
VAR v_Reference = MAX('Dim_Date'[Date])
VAR v_Snapshot = CALCULATE(MAX('Fact_ProjectCashFlow'[Snapshot Date]), 'Fact_ProjectCashFlow'[Phase] = v_Phase, 'Fact_ProjectCashFlow'[Snapshot Date] <= v_Reference)
VAR v_Project = SELECTEDVALUE('Dim_Project'[Project ID])
VAR v_Rate = CALCULATE(SELECTEDVALUE('SIM_ProjectAssumptions'[Discount Rate]), 'SIM_ProjectAssumptions'[Project ID] = v_Project, 'SIM_ProjectAssumptions'[Phase] = v_Phase)
VAR v_Flows = FILTER('Fact_ProjectCashFlow', 'Fact_ProjectCashFlow'[Phase] = v_Phase && NOT ISBLANK('Fact_ProjectCashFlow'[Equity Cash Flow]))
VAR v_FirstDate = MINX(v_Flows, 'Fact_ProjectCashFlow'[Date])
RETURN IF(NOT ISBLANK(v_Rate) && v_Rate > -1 && COUNTROWS(v_Flows) > 0 && HASONEVALUE('Dim_Project'[Project ID]), SUMX(v_Flows, 'Fact_ProjectCashFlow'[Equity Cash Flow] / POWER(1 + v_Rate, DIVIDE(DATEDIFF(v_FirstDate, 'Fact_ProjectCashFlow'[Date], DAY), 365))))

VAR v_Reference = MAX('Dim_Date'[Date])

RETURN IF(ISBLANK([KPI Comparative]), SWITCH(v_Mode, "Budget", "NO BUDGET", "Target", "NO TARGET", "Forecast", "NO FORECAST", "Custom", "SELECT VALID CUSTOM DATES / NO DATA", "Same Period of Selected Year", "SELECT COMPARISON YEAR / NO DATA", "Previous Period", IF([Selected Periodicity]="YTD", "PREVIOUS PERIOD NOT DEFINED FOR YTD", "NO COMPARATIVE DATA"), "NO COMPARATIVE DATA"), "COMPARATIVE AVAILABLE")

Management Reading.expr:
VAR v_Status = [KPI Status]
VAR v_Id = SELECTEDVALUE('SIM_KPI'[KPI ID])
VAR v_Delta = [KPI Variance]
RETURN SWITCH(TRUE(), v_Status = "PENDING RECONCILIATION", "Eliminações intercompany e cobertura ainda não reconciliadas.", v_Status = "PENDING MAPPING", "Classificar contas 24–28 e maturidade da dívida; não interpretar subtotal como total.", v_Status = "TAX SOURCE REQUIRED", "Resultado antes de imposto disponível; imposto aprovado necessário para resultado líquido.", v_Status = "SOURCE REQUIRED", "Fonte operacional necessária; valores do handover não foram importados como fatos.", ISBLANK([KPI Actual]), "Ausência de dados ou componente obrigatório; não é zero.", v_Id IN {"DSO","DPO"}, "Indicador aproximado; não substitui aging por fatura.", v_Id IN {"Funding Gap","Peak Funding Gap"} && [KPI Actual] > 0, "Necessidade de financiamento com base nas fontes disponíveis.", ISBLANK(v_Delta), [Comparison Status] & " | " & v_Status, "Variação " & FORMAT([KPI Variance %],"0.0%;(0.0%)") & " | " & v_Status)

KPI Display.expr: IF(ISBLANK([KPI Actual]), [KPI Status], FORMAT([KPI Actual], [KPI Format]))

Comparative Display.expr: IF(ISBLANK([KPI Comparative]), [Comparison Status], FORMAT([KPI Comparative], [KPI Format]))

KPI Unit.expr:
VAR v_Unit = SELECTEDVALUE('SIM_KPI'[Unit])
RETURN IF(v_Unit = "currency", SELECTEDVALUE('Dim_Project'[Currency], "CURRENCY REQUIRED"), v_Unit)

Dynamic Context.expr:
VAR v_RefDate = [Reference Date]
VAR v_Entity = [Selected Entity]
VAR v_Name = IF(v_Entity = "CON", "JSCV & KYENU — CONSOLIDATED | CHECK KPI RECONCILIATION STATUS", v_Entity)
RETURN v_Name & " | " & [Selected Periodicity] & " " & IF(ISBLANK(v_RefDate),"NO DATA",FORMAT(v_RefDate,"yyyy-MM")) & " | " & SELECTEDVALUE('SIM_Comparison'[Comparison],"Homologous Period") & " | Refresh UTC " & FORMAT(MAX('SIM_Refresh'[Last Refresh UTC]),"yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm")

Project Context.expr:
VAR v_Name = SELECTEDVALUE('Dim_Project'[Project Name], "SOURCE REQUIRED / SELECT PROJECT")
RETURN v_Name & " | Owner: " & SELECTEDVALUE('Dim_Project'[Owner],"NO DATA") & " | Developer: " & SELECTEDVALUE('Dim_Project'[Developer],"NO DATA") & " | Contractor: " & SELECTEDVALUE('Dim_Project'[Contractor],"NO DATA") & " | " & SELECTEDVALUE('Dim_Project'[Status],"NO DATA") & " | " & SELECTEDVALUE('Dim_Project'[Currency],"NO DATA")

Unit Relevant.expr:
VAR v_Projects = VALUES('Dim_Project'[Project ID])
RETURN IF(SELECTEDVALUE('Dim_Unit'[Project ID]) IN v_Projects, 1, 0)

Revenue Variance.expr: IF(NOT ISBLANK([Revenue Executive]) && NOT ISBLANK([Revenue Prior Year]), [Revenue Executive] - [Revenue Prior Year])

EBITDA Variance.expr: IF(NOT ISBLANK([EBITDA Executive]) && NOT ISBLANK([EBITDA Prior Year]), [EBITDA Executive] - [EBITDA Prior Year])

Phase Variance.expr: IF(NOT ISBLANK([Phase Current]) && NOT ISBLANK([Phase Baseline]), [Phase Current] - [Phase Baseline])

Phase Initial Display.expr: IF(ISBLANK([Phase Initial]), "NO DATA", FORMAT([Phase Initial], [KPI Format]))

Phase Baseline Display.expr: IF(ISBLANK([Phase Baseline]), "NO DATA", FORMAT([Phase Baseline], [KPI Format]))

Phase Current Display.expr: IF(ISBLANK([Phase Current]), "NO DATA", FORMAT([Phase Current], [KPI Format]))

Phase Forecast Display.expr: IF(ISBLANK([Phase Forecast]), "NO DATA", FORMAT([Phase Forecast], [KPI Format]))

Collection Feed Complete.expr:
VAR v_Company = SELECTEDVALUE('Dim_Company'[Company ID])
VAR v_Project = SELECTEDVALUE('Dim_Project'[Project ID])
VAR v_RefDate = MAX('Dim_Date'[Date])
VAR v_RowsAtDate = FILTER('SIM_SourceCoverage', 'SIM_SourceCoverage'[Company ID] = v_Company && 'SIM_SourceCoverage'[Project ID] = v_Project && 'SIM_SourceCoverage'[Feed] = "Collections" && 'SIM_SourceCoverage'[Reference Date] = EOMONTH(v_RefDate,0) && 'SIM_SourceCoverage'[Complete] = TRUE())
RETURN COUNTROWS(v_RowsAtDate) = 1

Collections Period.expr:
VAR v_StartDate = MIN('Dim_Date'[Date])
VAR v_EndDate = MAX('Dim_Date'[Date])
RETURN IF([Collection Feed Complete], CALCULATE(SUM('Fact_Collections'[Amount]), 'Fact_Collections'[Actual Collection Date] >= v_StartDate, 'Fact_Collections'[Actual Collection Date] <= v_EndDate, 'Fact_Collections'[Status] = "Paid"))

KPI Card Detail.expr: "vs " & [Comparative Display] & " | Δ " & IF(ISBLANK([KPI Variance %]), "—", FORMAT([KPI Variance %], "0.0%;(0.0%)")) & " | " & [KPI Status]

Collections Trend.expr:
VAR v_EndDate = [Context End]
VAR v_StartDate = IF(NOT ISBLANK(v_EndDate), DATE(YEAR(v_EndDate), MONTH(v_EndDate),1))
VAR v_Entity = [Selected Entity]
RETURN IF(v_Entity IN {"JSCV","KYENU"} && NOT ISBLANK(v_EndDate), CALCULATE([Collections Period], TREATAS({v_Entity},'Dim_Company'[Company ID]), REMOVEFILTERS('Dim_Date'), DATESBETWEEN('Dim_Date'[Date],v_StartDate,v_EndDate)))

KPI Coverage Missing.expr:
VAR v_Entity = [Selected Entity]
VAR v_StartDate = [Context Start]
VAR v_EndDate = [Context End]
VAR v_Kind = SELECTEDVALUE('SIM_KPI'[Kind])
VAR v_Id = SELECTEDVALUE('SIM_KPI'[KPI ID])
VAR v_Required = IF(NOT ISBLANK(v_StartDate) && NOT ISBLANK(v_EndDate), DATEDIFF(v_StartDate, v_EndDate, MONTH) + 1)
VAR v_GroupAvailable = SUMX({"JSCV","KYENU"}, VAR v_Company = [Value] RETURN CALCULATE(DISTINCTCOUNT('Fact_Accounting'[Period ID]), REMOVEFILTERS('Dim_Date'), REMOVEFILTERS('Dim_Company'), TREATAS({v_Company},'Dim_Company'[Company ID]), 'Fact_Accounting'[Period Date] >= v_StartDate, 'Fact_Accounting'[Period Date] <= v_EndDate))
VAR v_Available = CALCULATE(DISTINCTCOUNT('Fact_Accounting'[Period ID]), REMOVEFILTERS('Dim_Date'), TREATAS({v_Entity},'Dim_Company'[Company ID]), 'Fact_Accounting'[Period Date] >= v_StartDate, 'Fact_Accounting'[Period Date] <= v_EndDate)
VAR v_RevenueMonths = CALCULATE(DISTINCTCOUNT('Fact_Accounting'[Period ID]), REMOVEFILTERS('Dim_Date'), TREATAS({v_Entity},'Dim_Company'[Company ID]), 'Fact_Accounting'[Period Date] >= v_StartDate, 'Fact_Accounting'[Period Date] <= v_EndDate, 'Dim_Account'[Account Level] = 2, 'Dim_Account'[Management Group] = "Revenue")
RETURN IF(v_Id IN {"Revenue","Gross Profit","Gross Margin","EBITDA","EBITDA Margin","EBIT","EBIT Margin","Result Before Tax","Net Result","Net Margin","DSO"} && v_RevenueMonths > 0 && v_RevenueMonths < v_Required, TRUE(), IF(v_Kind = "Flow" || v_Id IN {"Gross Margin","EBITDA Margin","EBIT Margin","Net Margin","DSO","DPO"}, IF(v_Entity = "CON", 2 * v_Required > v_GroupAvailable, v_Required > v_Available), FALSE()))

Cash Available for Debt Service.expr: CALCULATE([Project Metric Raw], REMOVEFILTERS('SIM_KPI'), 'SIM_KPI'[KPI ID] = "Cash Available for Debt Service")

Debt Service.expr: CALCULATE([Project Metric Raw], REMOVEFILTERS('SIM_KPI'), 'SIM_KPI'[KPI ID] = "Debt Service")

Contract Row Visible.expr:
VAR v_Company = SELECTEDVALUE('Fact_SalesContracts'[Company ID])
RETURN IF(v_Company = [Selected Entity] && NOT ISBLANK(SELECTEDVALUE('Fact_SalesContracts'[Contract Date])) && SELECTEDVALUE('Fact_SalesContracts'[Contract Date]) <= [Reference Date], 1, 0)

Collection Row Visible.expr:
VAR v_Company = SELECTEDVALUE('Fact_Collections'[Company ID])
RETURN IF(v_Company = [Selected Entity] && NOT ISBLANK(SELECTEDVALUE('Fact_Collections'[Actual Collection Date])) && SELECTEDVALUE('Fact_Collections'[Actual Collection Date]) <= [Reference Date] && SELECTEDVALUE('Fact_Collections'[Status]) = "Paid", 1, 0)

Payment Plan Row Visible.expr:
VAR v_Company = SELECTEDVALUE('Fact_PaymentPlan'[Company ID])
RETURN IF(v_Company = [Selected Entity], 1, 0)

Accounting Row Relevant.expr:
VAR v_Company = [Selected Entity]
VAR v_Start = [Context Start]
VAR v_End = [Context End]
VAR v_Rows = CALCULATE(COUNTROWS('Fact_Accounting'), TREATAS({v_Company}, 'Dim_Company'[Company ID]), REMOVEFILTERS('Dim_Date'), DATESBETWEEN('Dim_Date'[Date], v_Start, v_End))
RETURN IF(v_Rows > 0, 1, 0)

KPI Target Direction.expr:
VAR v_Entity = [Selected Entity]
VAR v_RefDate = [Context End]
VAR v_Period = [Selected Periodicity]
VAR v_Id = SELECTEDVALUE('SIM_KPI'[KPI ID])
VAR v_Version = SELECTEDVALUE('SIM_Version'[Version])
VAR v_Project = SELECTEDVALUE('Dim_Project'[Project ID], "")
VAR v_Unit = [KPI Unit]
VAR v_Plan = FILTER('Fact_KPIPlans', 'Fact_KPIPlans'[Entity Key] = v_Entity && 'Fact_KPIPlans'[Project ID] = v_Project && 'Fact_KPIPlans'[Period Date] = v_RefDate && 'Fact_KPIPlans'[Periodicity] = v_Period && 'Fact_KPIPlans'[KPI ID] = v_Id && 'Fact_KPIPlans'[Kind] = "TARGET" && 'Fact_KPIPlans'[Version] = v_Version && 'Fact_KPIPlans'[Approved] = TRUE() && 'Fact_KPIPlans'[Unit] = v_Unit)
RETURN IF(NOT ISBLANK(v_Version) && COUNTROWS(v_Plan) = 1, MAXX(v_Plan,'Fact_KPIPlans'[Desired Direction]))
KPI Target Direction.desc: Higher or Lower from the approved target source; missing direction cannot classify performance.

KPI Consolidated Atom.expr:
VAR v_Id = SELECTEDVALUE('SIM_KPI'[KPI ID])
VAR v_Kind = SELECTEDVALUE('SIM_KPI'[Kind])
VAR v_Start = MIN('Dim_Date'[Date])
VAR v_End = MAX('Dim_Date'[Date])
VAR v_Required = IF(v_Kind = "Stock", 1, COUNTROWS(SUMMARIZE('Dim_Date','Dim_Date'[Period ID])))
VAR v_JSCV = CALCULATE([KPI Base], REMOVEFILTERS('Dim_Company'), 'Dim_Company'[Company ID] = "JSCV")
VAR v_KYENU = CALCULATE([KPI Base], REMOVEFILTERS('Dim_Company'), 'Dim_Company'[Company ID] = "KYENU")
VAR v_Approvals = FILTER('Fact_Intercompany', 'Fact_Intercompany'[KPI ID] = v_Id && 'Fact_Intercompany'[Reconciliation Status] = "APPROVED" && NOT ISBLANK('Fact_Intercompany'[Signed Adjustment]) && IF(v_Kind = "Stock", 'Fact_Intercompany'[Period Date] = EOMONTH(v_End,0), 'Fact_Intercompany'[Period Date] >= v_Start && 'Fact_Intercompany'[Period Date] <= v_End))
RETURN IF(v_Kind IN {"Flow","Stock"} && NOT ISBLANK(v_JSCV) && NOT ISBLANK(v_KYENU) && COUNTROWS(v_Approvals) = v_Required, v_JSCV + v_KYENU + SUMX(v_Approvals,'Fact_Intercompany'[Signed Adjustment]))
KPI Consolidated Atom.desc: Both companies and approved signed elimination records required for every period. Explicit approved zero adjustment is valid; absent adjustment is not zero.

KPI Consolidated Value.expr:
VAR v_Revenue = CALCULATE([KPI Consolidated Atom], REMOVEFILTERS('SIM_KPI'), 'SIM_KPI'[KPI ID] = "Revenue")
VAR v_DirectCosts = CALCULATE([KPI Consolidated Atom], REMOVEFILTERS('SIM_KPI'), 'SIM_KPI'[KPI ID] = "Direct Costs")
VAR v_FSE = CALCULATE([KPI Consolidated Atom], REMOVEFILTERS('SIM_KPI'), 'SIM_KPI'[KPI ID] = "FSE")
VAR v_Payroll = CALCULATE([KPI Consolidated Atom], REMOVEFILTERS('SIM_KPI'), 'SIM_KPI'[KPI ID] = "Payroll")
VAR v_OtherOperatingCosts = CALCULATE([KPI Consolidated Atom], REMOVEFILTERS('SIM_KPI'), 'SIM_KPI'[KPI ID] = "Other Operating Costs")
VAR v_OtherOperatingIncome = CALCULATE([KPI Consolidated Atom], REMOVEFILTERS('SIM_KPI'), 'SIM_KPI'[KPI ID] = "Other Operating Income")
VAR v_DA = CALCULATE([KPI Consolidated Atom], REMOVEFILTERS('SIM_KPI'), 'SIM_KPI'[KPI ID] = "D&A")
VAR v_FinanceIncome = CALCULATE([KPI Consolidated Atom], REMOVEFILTERS('SIM_KPI'), 'SIM_KPI'[KPI ID] = "Finance Income")
VAR v_FinanceCosts = CALCULATE([KPI Consolidated Atom], REMOVEFILTERS('SIM_KPI'), 'SIM_KPI'[KPI ID] = "Finance Costs")
VAR v_IncomeTax = CALCULATE([KPI Consolidated Atom], REMOVEFILTERS('SIM_KPI'), 'SIM_KPI'[KPI ID] = "Income Tax")
VAR v_Cash = CALCULATE([KPI Consolidated Atom], REMOVEFILTERS('SIM_KPI'), 'SIM_KPI'[KPI ID] = "Cash")
VAR v_AccountsReceivable = CALCULATE([KPI Consolidated Atom], REMOVEFILTERS('SIM_KPI'), 'SIM_KPI'[KPI ID] = "Accounts Receivable")
VAR v_AccountsPayable = CALCULATE([KPI Consolidated Atom], REMOVEFILTERS('SIM_KPI'), 'SIM_KPI'[KPI ID] = "Accounts Payable")
VAR v_InventoryWIP = CALCULATE([KPI Consolidated Atom], REMOVEFILTERS('SIM_KPI'), 'SIM_KPI'[KPI ID] = "Inventory / WIP")
VAR v_CurrentAssets = CALCULATE([KPI Consolidated Atom], REMOVEFILTERS('SIM_KPI'), 'SIM_KPI'[KPI ID] = "Current Assets")
VAR v_CurrentLiabilities = CALCULATE([KPI Consolidated Atom], REMOVEFILTERS('SIM_KPI'), 'SIM_KPI'[KPI ID] = "Current Liabilities")
VAR v_Debt = CALCULATE([KPI Consolidated Atom], REMOVEFILTERS('SIM_KPI'), 'SIM_KPI'[KPI ID] = "Debt")
VAR v_Equity = CALCULATE([KPI Consolidated Atom], REMOVEFILTERS('SIM_KPI'), 'SIM_KPI'[KPI ID] = "Equity")
VAR v_GrossProfit = IF(NOT ISBLANK(v_Revenue) && NOT ISBLANK(v_DirectCosts), v_Revenue - v_DirectCosts)
VAR v_EBITDA = IF(NOT ISBLANK(v_Revenue) && NOT ISBLANK(v_OtherOperatingIncome) && NOT ISBLANK(v_DirectCosts) && NOT ISBLANK(v_FSE) && NOT ISBLANK(v_Payroll) && NOT ISBLANK(v_OtherOperatingCosts), v_Revenue + v_OtherOperatingIncome - v_DirectCosts - v_FSE - v_Payroll - v_OtherOperatingCosts)
VAR v_EBIT = IF(NOT ISBLANK(v_EBITDA) && NOT ISBLANK(v_DA), v_EBITDA - v_DA)
VAR v_NetFinance = IF(NOT ISBLANK(v_FinanceIncome) && NOT ISBLANK(v_FinanceCosts), v_FinanceIncome - v_FinanceCosts)
VAR v_BeforeTax = IF(NOT ISBLANK(v_EBIT) && NOT ISBLANK(v_NetFinance), v_EBIT + v_NetFinance)
VAR v_NetResult = IF(NOT ISBLANK(v_BeforeTax) && NOT ISBLANK(v_IncomeTax), v_BeforeTax - v_IncomeTax)
RETURN SWITCH(SELECTEDVALUE('SIM_KPI'[KPI ID]),
 "Gross Profit", v_GrossProfit,
 "Gross Margin", DIVIDE(v_GrossProfit,v_Revenue),
 "EBITDA", v_EBITDA,
 "EBITDA Margin", DIVIDE(v_EBITDA,v_Revenue),
 "EBIT", v_EBIT,
 "EBIT Margin", DIVIDE(v_EBIT,v_Revenue),
 "Net Finance", v_NetFinance,
 "Result Before Tax", v_BeforeTax,
 "Net Result", v_NetResult,
 "Net Margin", DIVIDE(v_NetResult,v_Revenue),
 "Working Capital", IF(NOT ISBLANK(v_CurrentAssets) && NOT ISBLANK(v_CurrentLiabilities),v_CurrentAssets-v_CurrentLiabilities),
 "Net Debt", IF(NOT ISBLANK(v_Debt) && NOT ISBLANK(v_Cash),v_Debt-v_Cash),
 "Current Ratio", DIVIDE(v_CurrentAssets,v_CurrentLiabilities),
 "Quick Ratio", IF(NOT ISBLANK(v_CurrentAssets) && NOT ISBLANK(v_InventoryWIP),DIVIDE(v_CurrentAssets-v_InventoryWIP,v_CurrentLiabilities)),
 "Immediate Liquidity", DIVIDE(v_Cash,v_CurrentLiabilities),
 "DSO", DIVIDE(v_AccountsReceivable,v_Revenue) * COUNTROWS(VALUES('Dim_Date'[Date])),
 "DPO", DIVIDE(v_AccountsPayable,v_DirectCosts) * COUNTROWS(VALUES('Dim_Date'[Date])),
 [KPI Consolidated Atom])

KPI Card Value.expr:
VAR v_Amount = [KPI Actual]
VAR v_Unit = [KPI Unit]
RETURN IF(ISBLANK(v_Amount), [KPI Status], IF(v_Unit IN {"CVE","EUR"}, IF(ABS(v_Amount) >= 1000000, FORMAT(v_Amount / 1000000,"0.0") & " M " & v_Unit, IF(ABS(v_Amount) >= 1000, FORMAT(v_Amount / 1000,"0.0") & " K " & v_Unit, FORMAT(v_Amount,"#,0.0") & " " & v_Unit)), FORMAT(v_Amount,[KPI Format])))
KPI Card Value.desc: Short management number format for cards; detailed matrices retain unscaled values.
